lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: aim case expectations at what a reader would misjudge
lines.text: - This case checks that independent fixes under one motive become separate parts. `partsApart` holds each pair of the five fix files: `scripts/gui-drive.sh`, `scripts/smoke-docker.sh`, `tests/demo_sections.h`, `pages-review.ts`, and `src/core/stb_ds.c`, except the Docker smoke and stb_ds pair. Both are build fixes, so one build-fixes part is fine if each keeps its own group. With that part and the agent docs folded into another part, the review has 4 parts. The `apart` pairs keep the Docker smoke and stb_ds groups apart, so a review has at least 5 groups. The agent docs have no part expect. `tests/deck_app_input_harness.c`, `tests/smoke_harness.c`, and `AGENTS.md` hold hunks of more than one story, so they have no expect.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: list only the commits of the change in the grading packet
lines.text: - The demo count, stb_ds, and Docker smoke stories each keep one Must for their core change, because no other Must covers that part of the diff. The `AGENTS.md` screenshot rule is a Must because it hides in the Pages commit, the PR body does not mention it, and it changes where PR evidence lives. Outside the diff, `.github/workflows/pages-reviews.yml` prunes the whole PR folder, `evidence/` included, when the PR closes, so screenshot links in a merged PR body stop working.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: aim case expectations at what a reader would misjudge
lines.text: - The PR body says the stb_ds implementation leaves `main.c` and 13 harnesses. The hunks touch 12 harness files, but `CMakeLists.txt` builds `tests/js_limits_harness.c` twice (`js_limits_harness` and `js_limits_vita_stack_harness`), so 13 is right. A past run flagged it as a mismatch.
